question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The entire environment was very __hostile__ towards us.
solution:
The correct answer is** FAVOURABLE.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Let's see the meaning of the antonym with an example:

__
 
• **HOSTILE **means unfriendly and not liking something.(शत्रुतापूर्ण)

 
 
• ***Eg. ***The president had a* hostile *reception in Ohio this morning 
 
 
 
• **FAVOURABLE **means showing that you like or approve of someone or something.(अनुकूल)
 
 
• ***Eg.*** We have had a *favourable* response to the plan so far.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here we see the Antonym of the other given words:

 
• ANTAGONISTIC - sympathetic( 

 
 
• Antagonistic means showing or feeling active opposition or hostility towards someone or something(विरोधी)
 
• ​EXAMPLE - he was *antagonistic* to the government's reforms.
 
 
 
• ACCURATE - inaccurate
 
 
• Accurate means providing a faithful representation of someone or something.(शुद्ध)
 
• EXAMPLE - the portrait is an *accurate* likeness of Mozart
 
 
 
• HANDY - inconvenient
 
 
• **Handy **means something that is useful.(सुविधाजनक)
 
• **EXAMPLE** - The book gives** handy** hints on looking after plants.
